summary: 5-phase implementation plan for LJ intuitionistic sequent calculus. Phase 1: LJProof inductive with 11 constructors, height, mono, CutFree (2h). Phase 2: Kripke soundness via IForces (2.5h). Phase 3: Cut elimination / Hauptsatz (5h). Phase 4: ND-LJ and Hilbert-LJ equivalence bridges (4h). Phase 5: Barrel files and CI verification (1.5h). Total: 16h. Phases 2 and 3 can execute in parallel (Wave 2).

artifacts.summary: Phased implementation plan with dependency analysis, file-level task breakdown, and verification criteria for each phase
